title: TimeFloats: Train-in-Memory with Time-Domain Floating-Point Scalar Products
problem: Compute-in-memory (CIM) lacks floating-point training capability; conventional ADC/DAC costly in advanced nodes
motivation: DNN training in memory attractive for efficiency; floating-point precision needed; ADC/DAC power/complexity limiting
method: TimeFloats: time-domain floating-point scalar products avoiding ADC/DAC; pure digital building blocks in 15nm CMOS
key_novelty: Time-domain floating-point CIM for training without conventional converters; 22.1 TOPS/W efficiency
